businesses.business: concrete pumping and waste management services

offering_description.value: Provides concrete pumping services with a fleet of boom, line and placing-boom pumps to commercial, infrastructure and residential contractors in the US, UK and other markets. Also provides containerized waste removal and disposal services to industrial and construction customers. Delivers services with its own branch network, equipment and operators.

primary_services.value: concrete pumping; containerized waste removal and disposal; pump rental with operators

customer_segment.value: B2B: general and concrete contractors in commercial, infrastructure and residential construction, industrial facilities for waste services

end_markets.value: commercial construction; infrastructure; residential construction; industrial maintenance

revenue_model.value: service fees: hourly and per-job charges for concrete pumping and waste container service; rental or leasing: pump equipment rental, sometimes with operators

value_chain_position.value: service provider: uses owned pump trucks and operators to place concrete for contractors; asset operator: owns and runs fleet of concrete pumps and waste containers across branches

geography_served.value: global: United States, United Kingdom, plus Canada and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: concrete pumping plus containerized waste services for construction and industrial customers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: network of branch locations dispatching pumps and operators; direct sales: direct relationships with contractors and national accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: road transport and vehicle rules (DOT), OSHA workplace safety, and environmental waste handling regulations
